name: kicom-expansion-living-cell/2
perception_action_loop: observe -> remember -> derive capabilities/boundaries -> act -> observe result -> update perception/action memory
birth_policy: all intrinsic subsystems materialized and verified before node initialization commits
evolution_policy: candidate creation and deterministic static fitness remain available; executable autonomous promotion is deferred until perception/action memory is verified
external_boundary_policy: human authorization only when a protected external system, credential or permission requires it
inheritance_policy: architecture may be inherited; identity, secrets, mutable state and project memory are local
